proof:
intro P hP lam z
have hprod {R : Type} [CommRing R] {ι : Type}
    (s : Finset ι) (f : ι → ℕ) :
    (∏ i ∈ s, (-1 : R) ^ f i) = 1 ∨
      (∏ i ∈ s, (-1 : R) ^ f i) = -1 := by
  classical
  induction s using Finset.induction_on with
  | empty => simp
  | @insert a s ha ih =>
      rw [Finset.prod_insert ha]
      rcases neg_one_pow_eq_or (R := R) (f a) with h | h <;>
        rcases ih with hs | hs <;> simp [h, hs]
exact hprod Finset.univ _
